sections.title: Ask for and give directions
sections.content: Combine questions about location and destination with simple directions to help someone find a place.

sections.title: Useful interaction
rows: How do I get to the market?

items.english: How do I get to the museum?

items.spanish: Ve al centro y gira a la derecha.
items.english: Go to the centre and turn right.

sections.content: Keep the interaction simple: ask where the place is or how to get there, then give one or two clear directions.
